task: Train cardplay policy with Claude spot-card bidder auctions and optional Gen6 bidding-system information
authorization: Max, 11 November 2026: train a new policy net using the new bidding system; support unspecified and known system inference
blocker: Claude spot-card-aware bidder not identified among currently accessible repository branches. Claude joint-auction-belief branch52797cee uses the old Gen5 bidder.
inputs: existing player-visible cards and public play history
optional per-seat public system ID with explicit known mask
unknown_mode: Mask system metadata only. Retain observed auction and play so inference can learn evidence about bidding behavior. Never expose hidden actor/model identity through another input.
model_work_pending: Integrate optional context into policy with parent-preserving initialization; verify portable inference, save/restore and omission defaults before fitting.
data_rules: Bind Gen6 label only after verifying exact new bidder code/model and auction-generation settings.
Use eligible records actually generated with this bidder, or generate new auctions and legally played continuations with frozen cardplay settings.
Never attach outcomes from old contracts/auctions to newly generated auctions, even when the deal or final contract agrees.
Mix eligible historical data with new-system data; preserve whole-family splits and all existing explicit evaluation reservations, including the fixed100 Gen6-versus5RZ families.
Freeze dataset, source, generator and parent hashes before fitting. Do not substitute the mismatched historical training archive.
Mask metadata as training views without multiplying family weight or moving any views across splits.
validation: Select with epochzero eligible. Report family-paired outcome MSE and uncertainty separately for declared and unspecified systems, with common held-out families and frozen Gen5 comparator; mixed declared partnerships as secondary robustness. Freeze candidate before fresh confirmation. Prediction gain is not automatically whole-game IMP gain.
future_notes: Keep an extensible versioned system registry. Train explicit structured convention features or a text encoder before claiming arbitrary added notes affect inference.
deployment: Separate candidate; no arena changes or repeated earlier Gen6 fits
